motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of June 23, 2026, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Allen seconded…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to approve the minutes of June 23, 2026, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: June 23 minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission signed off on the minutes of its June 23, 2026 meeting.
motions.impact: This is the housekeeping that makes the written record of that meeting official. You will not feel it anywhere.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Scenic Mountain Rezone. Commissioner Stron…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Scenic Mountain Rezone. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Scenic Mountain zoning change recommended
motions.summary: The commission asked the City Council to approve the Scenic Mountain rezone; the motion names no acreage, location, or new zoning district.
motions.impact: Land use does not change until the council votes. Residents who care what gets built there should follow the item to that meeting.

motions.item_title: Table Item 7.B., Eagle Mountain Chapel and Recreation Building Site Plan. Commissioner Strong s…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to table Item 7.B., Eagle Mountain Chapel and Recreation Building Site Plan. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Chapel and rec building site plan shelved
motions.summary: The site plan for the Eagle Mountain Chapel and Recreation Building was set aside by the commission for a later meeting.
motions.impact: The plan sits where it is until the commission picks it up again. Nobody's property or paperwork changes in the meantime.

motions.item_title: Table Item 7.C., Eagle Mountain Chapel and Recreation Building Development Agreement. Commissio…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to table Item 7.C., Eagle Mountain Chapel and Recreation Building Development Agreement. Commissioner Free seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Chapel development agreement put on hold
motions.summary: The commission postponed the development agreement for the Eagle Mountain Chapel and Recreation Building without acting on it.
motions.impact: No decision was reached about the chapel project. The motion sets no return date, so the record does not say when the item comes back.

motions.item_title: Deny Item 7.D., Wright Retaining Wall Variance, based on the following criteria: 1. There is en…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to deny Item 7.D., Wright Retaining Wall Variance, based on the following criteria: 1. There is enough buildable area on the property to build a tiered wall, that would meet the City's standards for retaining walls. It is not an unreasonable hardship if there is still buildable area available for use. Having sloped land does not make the subject property unique and is a general condition to the neighborhood. 2. The property is not deprived of privileges granted to other properties in the same district. 3. It may be in the public interest to have tiered retaining walls that blend better with the natural topography. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Retaining wall variance denied on Wright property
motions.summary: The commission turned down a request to bypass the city's retaining wall rules, finding the lot has room for a tiered wall meeting standards.
motions.impact: The owner must build to the city's tiered wall standard rather than the wall proposed. Sloped ground on its own will not win a variance, which matters to anyone with a hillside lot.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., Brylee Townhomes Development Agreement Fir…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., Brylee Townhomes Development Agreement First Amendment. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Brylee Townhomes agreement change backed
motions.summary: A first amendment to the Brylee Townhomes development agreement won the commission's support, with the decision left to the City Council.
motions.impact: The council has the last word here, so the amendment is not in force. Neighbors of the townhome site will see no change from this step.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.F., Stadion Development Agreement First Amendm…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.F., Stadion Development Agreement First Amendment. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Stadion development deal change sent to council
motions.summary: The commission backed a first amendment to the Stadion development agreement and passed it to the City Council for the final vote.
motions.impact: Nothing changes on the ground from this vote. The council takes it up later and can decide otherwise.
